page: Microsoft Azure EC4ads_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ECadsv6 family. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server includes 154 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-performance external disk attachments. It does not include any integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its high memory density relative to the vCPU count, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that require significant memory footprints without needing massive compute scaling. It is well-suited for memory-intensive applications, database caching layers, small-to-medium relational databases, and enterprise applications that benefit from local temporary storage.
